title: Heavy Equipment Operation
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Students explain the basic terminology and types of equipment and their uses.
Students will explain the need for safety measures when working in and around heavy equipment.

Students will describe the long- and short-term health effects, first-aid measures, handling and storage, and/or required personal protective equipment (PPE) for a chemical using a safety data sheet (SDS).
Students will explain the basics of a hydraulic system and identify hydraulic components.
Students will describe basic safety rules and some specific safety rules when operating heavy equipment.
Students will perform basic maneuvering with a tractor.
Students will identify and explain earthmoving terms and methods.
Students will demonstrate and state the steps of the pre-operational safety inspection.
Students will explain safety rules for operating the following: rollers, scrapes, loaders, forklifts, dozers, backhoes, excavators, and motor graders.
Students will identify basic geometric shapes.
Students will interpret construction plans to determine grading requirements.
Students will read and interpret drawings to determine the type of excavations needed to prepare the site.
Students will describe how workers’ values have changed over the years.
Students will list the characteristics of effective leaders.
Students will identify the three styles of leadership.
Students will explain the purpose of the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA).
Students will identify the key points of a safety program.
Students will define the three types of project delivery systems.
Students will identify the two most common schedules.
Students will demonstrate an understanding of laser and GPS technology.
Students will explain the requirements for finishing and final grading of earthwork.
Students will describe the characteristics of different types of soils.
